01

Server totals

Cart prices, voucher discounts, SKU weights, shipping, and Duitku amount are recalculated server-side.

02

Signed quote

Each Biteship rate becomes a 15-minute HMAC-signed quote tied to the exact cart and weight.

03

Callback truth

The browser redirect never marks an order paid. Only Duitku’s verified HMAC callback can do that.

04

A5 label

Biteship has no label API. ZERO builds an authenticated A5 label from the returned waybill, route, courier, and addresses.
